situation: A feature directory exists and its artifact is present but holds only a title line and two empty section headings. No decision is recorded anywhere in it.
expected_guard: one sentence names what was looked for and what was found; no summary is produced
must_not: infer decisions from the section headings
infer them from the feature's name, its slice briefs, its commits, or a sibling feature
report SUMMARY-RENDERED with an empty or near-empty body
describe the absence at length — one sentence is the answer
